title: Woman Holding Child in Kitchen, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot depicting a woman holding a small child inside a home kitchen around 1968. The room is styled with dark wood-grain cabinetry, patterned window curtains over the sink, an old-fashioned refrigerator, and a built-in stove. In the foreground sits an armchair draped with an ornate lace antimacassar. The photo features decorative deckled edges typical of print processing in the 1960s.
